title: `broadcast_in_dim` ignores non-increasing `broadcast_dimensions` if the shape is unchanged
description: and its docstring shows `broadcast_dimensions=(1, 0)` as an implicit transpose.
If the result shape equals the operand shape, the result is silently wrong:
JAX returns the operand unchanged instead of permuting its axes.
`_broadcast_in_dim_fwd_rule` forwards the operand whenever `shape` equals the operand shape.
It does not check that `broadcast_dimensions` is the identity.
The equation is dropped from the jaxpr, also in eager mode and in derivatives.
This is a bug of a forwarding rule and not of a differentiation rule, so the Lean model does not cover it.
reproducer: # For a square operand, JAX returns the operand instead of its transpose.
# The equation is missing from the jaxpr.
